rawRecord.short_description: Aggregates multiple MCP servers into a single unified platform with hot-pluggable tools and access control.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCPHub transforms scattered MCP server deployments into one centralized platform. Clients configure a single endpoint to access all available tools, which can be enabled or disabled without restarting the service. The platform supports proxying existing MCP servers, AI-powered code generation for custom plugins, group-based access control for different AI clients, and built-in usage statistics dashboards. Requires Python 3.10+.
